prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP NISHA adult woman work-shift accountant waiting for her still-missing brother: short brown hair held in modest russet kerchief, desaturated green long work dress with dark apron, one CLOSED unmarked ledger against hip, tired intent face. BOTTOM SALER adult male remittance-token intermediary, proposed mature lean man with narrow beard and brown hair, dull plum wool coat over tan tunic, small closed leather pouch held low, a separate plain belt purse. No money changing hands, no completed ransom, no person returning, no implied forgiven theft. Ledger remains blank closed, bags have no quantities.
